source_message.text:
Project Timeline - Six weeks
Milestone - 1350 USD

The second milestone covers:
1\. Complete the Meet Alfred set up
2\. Create and configure a Zapier account
3\. Using Zap, connect Hubspot with Meet Alfred
4\. Create a Domain, then Warm it up
5\. Configure an automated LinkedIn Campaign in Meet Alfred
6\. Configure an automated Email Campaign in Meet Alfred
7\. Map the data flow running from Meet Alfred to Hubspot
8\. Build a Lead Management System in Hubspot
9\. Produce different types of reporting
